summary.text: Vandana Slatter is a Democratic member of the Washington State Senate representing District 48, appointed on January 7, 2025, and she is the only candidate listed for the seat in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A licensed pharmacist and clinical scientist, she previously served on the Bellevue city council and in the state House.

paragraphs.text: Vandana Slatter earned a bachelor's degree in pharmacy from the University of British Columbia, a Doctor of Pharmacy from the University of Washington, and a Master of Public Administration from the Evans School of Public Affairs at the University of Washington.
Her career experience includes working as a licensed pharmacist and clinical scientist.
Slatter served as a Bellevue city councilmember and then in the Washington House of Representatives for District 48, Position 1, from 2017 to 2025.
The Metropolitan King County Council appointed her to the state Senate seat for District 48 on January 7, 2025, to replace Patty Kuderer.
She advanced from the August 5, 2025 special primary for the seat alongside Amy Walen.
